resources.string: Lets a viewer you approve tap, swipe and type on this device while you share your screen with ShareScreen. It does nothing unless you have given someone control, and it only reads the text field that is being typed into remotely.
If the switch is greyed out, open App info for ShareScreen, tap ⋮ and choose Allow restricted settings.

ShareScreen's accessibility service lets a viewer you approve tap, swipe and type on this device while you share your screen.

It only acts while you have given someone control. To type, it reads the text field being typed into; it does not collect, store or send anything else from your screen.

You can turn it off at any time in the accessibility settings.
%1$s wants to watch your screen over the internet.
%1$s wants to control this device. They will be able to tap, swipe and type as if they were holding it.
Scan the QR code shown on the sharing device
